comparison.objective: Square and push a fixed-wheel rover onto a charging dock; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-object planar alignment and pushing versus recessed fine-tool alignment, hammering, and tiny-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Rover seated on dock versus four tangs fractured and contained with coils retained. Dock tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Docking tests mobile-object pose correction rather than controlled material separation.
